scientific_integrity: The coefficient identity is proved for all dimensions by pairwise Gaussian covariance bounds and a disjoint-block argument. Achievability uses admissible linear and zero coordinate transforms. The singular example is represented explicitly by two independent Gaussian factors. Finite computation is used only to replay algebraic consequences of the proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to standardized Gaussian vectors whose graph of negative correlations is a matching. It does not determine the copositivity coefficient for general signed correlation graphs. Search noncoverage cannot exclude an equivalent classical argument under different Gaussian-association or maximal-correlation terminology.
title: Exact Gaussian copositivity when negative correlations form a matching
